SHOEBOX.definition: A structure resembling a shoebox (as a rectangular building or a cramped room or compartment).

SHOE.gloss: footwear shaped to fit the foot with a flexible upper of leather or plastic and a sole…
SHOE.definition: Footwear shaped to fit the foot (below the ankle) with a flexible upper of leather or plastic and a sole and heel of heavier material.

HOSE.gloss: socks and stockings and tights collectively
HOSE.definition: Socks and stockings and tights collectively (the British include underwear).

BOSH.gloss: pretentious or silly talk or writing
BOSH.definition: Pretentious or silly talk or writing.

SEX.example: They had sex in the back seat.

BOX.gloss: a container; may have a lid
BOX.definition: A (usually rectangular) container; may have a lid.
BOX.example: He rummaged through a box of spare parts.

BOO.gloss: show displeasure, as after a performance or speech
BOO.definition: Show displeasure, as after a performance or speech.

OOH.gloss: express admiration and pleasure by uttering `ooh' or `aah'
OOH.definition: Express admiration and pleasure by uttering `ooh' or `aah'.
OOH.example: They oohed and aahed when they unwrapped the presents.
